enchantments.tooltip: Flaming Blast 6: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 6d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Coruscating 6: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 6d6 Light damage on each hit.
Overwhelming Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with overwhelming fire damage.
